lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance are observed intersecting with the circular blobs, creating identifiable grid-like nodes across the visible trunk.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high reflection above to deep shadow below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregularities and potential tissue loss are visible along the posterior margin (trailing edge) of the primary pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple high-contrast, elongated organisms (remoras) are attached to the ventral-lateral surface and the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
